name: Can I replace a light fixture myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace a light fixture myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While some simple light fixture replacements can be a DIY project for those with electrical experience, it's generally recommended to hire a professional, especially for more complex installations or if you are uncomfortable working with electricity. Electrical work carries risks, and improper installation can lead to hazards like short circuits or fires. A professional ensures safety, compliance, and correct functionality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a professional is recommended for most light fixture replacements due to electrical safety risks and to ensure proper installation.
